tbesh_html:
1) yesterday, recently, formerly
1a) yesterday
1b) formerly (fig.)
1c) from yesterday, already (in phrase)
2) (TWOT +) before, before that time, before the time, heretofore, of late, of old, these days, time(s) past

strongs_1890.derivation: or אִתְמוֹל; or אֶתְמוּל; probably from H853 (אֵת) or H854 (אֵת) and H4136 (מוּל);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [phrase] before (that) time, [phrase] heretofore, of late (old), [phrase] times past, yester(day).
